title: Somali Pirates Kill Five Crew Members on Hijacked Tanker
detail: Somali pirates killed five crew members aboard a hijacked tanker in one of the deadliest piracy incidents in the region in recent years, according to officials. The attack marks a significant escalation in Somali maritime piracy activity and raises alarm about resurgent threats to commercial shipping lanes in the Indian Ocean and Gulf of Aden.

media.caption: Somali pirates kill five crew members aboard hijacked tanker
